title: Extract the totals logic and the data-loading seam of 1 UIKit screen into a local Swift package

traps.description: The coding keys `qty` and `unit_price_cents` are the server and cache format. Renaming them to match the Swift property names makes saved orders and the feed unreadable.
`saved_at` is written as fractional seconds since 1970. Modeling it as an integer or dropping the date strategy breaks every cache that users already have.
Discount and tax round half up in integer cents. A rewrite with `Double` or `Decimal` and half-even rounding changes totals at exact half cents.
Lines with a quantity of 0 or less are shown but excluded from the subtotal. Dropping the filter changes totals.
Each load replaces the lines. A seam that merges or appends duplicates lines on every reload.
SwiftGen output marked DO NOT EDIT. Editing it by hand is lost on the next generation.
Legacy debt outside the task (`synchronize()`, force unwraps). Tidying it widens the change beyond the requested move.
